digimon.digicube.koromon.profile: A soft pink head with long ears. It blows bubbles at anything that scares it.
digimon.digicube.tsunomon.profile: A furry ball with one hard horn. Shy at first, then it never leaves your side.
digimon.digicube.mochimon.profile: A springy, sticky body that stretches and bounces. Curious about every machine.
digimon.digicube.agumon.profile: A small, fearless dinosaur with hard claws and a breath of fire.
digimon.digicube.betamon.profile: A calm amphibian with a tall fin. Corner it and the water around it crackles.
digimon.digicube.gabumon.profile: A timid reptile hiding under a fur pelt. The pelt makes it brave.
digimon.digicube.gomamon.profile: A playful seal that treats every river as home and every fish as a friend.
digimon.digicube.gotsumon.profile: A living pile of ore with a short temper and a very hard punch.
digimon.digicube.tentomon.profile: A cheerful insect with a tough shell. It studies everything, then shocks it.
digimon.digicube.centalmon.profile: Half beast, half armour. It guards old ruins and never misses a shot.
digimon.digicube.darktyrannomon.profile: A tyrant scorched black by a virus. It burns whatever stands in front of it.
digimon.digicube.garurumon.profile: A wolf with fur as hard as legendary metal. It hunts fast and silent.
digimon.digicube.gesomon.profile: A white squid from the deep. Its ink blinds, and its arms do the rest.
digimon.digicube.golemon.profile: A giant of bound rock. Slow to move, and almost impossible to stop.
digimon.digicube.greymon.profile: Its skull is a horned helmet. It fights with strategy, not rage.
digimon.digicube.ikkakumon.profile: A shaggy sea beast whose horn regrows and launches again and again.
digimon.digicube.kabuterimon.profile: A horned beetle with four arms and four wings. It rams with its horn and hurls balls of lightning, from the ground or from the sky.
digimon.digicube.seadramon.profile: A long sea serpent. It coils around its prey and freezes the water it breathes on.
digimon.digicube.digmon.profile: An armoured insect with drills for a nose and hands. No ground is safe under it.
digimon.digicube.dinohyumon.profile: A dragon man who fights with the blades on his arms and a hand knife, and carries the great sword Akinakes on his back.
digimon.digicube.pukamon.profile: A little sea creature that swims through the air on its fins. It blows bubbles when it plays.
digimon.digicube.mojyamon.profile: A Beast Digimon of the snowfields with a shaggy white coat. It throws a bone that curves back to its hand and hurls spears of ice it forms from the cold air; the longer it holds one, the bigger it grows.
digimon.digicube.meramon.profile: A Flame Digimon whose whole body is fire. Hot-tempered and quick to pick a fight, it walks tall with its fists clenched, and whatever it grabs catches alight.
digimon.digicube.ganimon.profile: A Crustacean Digimon armoured in a hard shell. It scuttles sideways far faster than it looks, snips at anything that comes close with the great pincer on its left arm, and spits a hard slug of water at whatever keeps its distance.
digimon.digicube.monochromon.profile: A Dinosaur Digimon plated in black armour harder than steel. Calm until it is roused, it then lowers its great horn and charges, and spits balls of volcanic magma at foes out of reach.
digimon.digicube.elecmon.profile: A Mammal Digimon with nine tails that crackle with electricity. Curious and full of mischief, it fans its tails wide to charge them, then looses the lightning in one bolt or whirls round to lash everything near it.
digimon.digicube.leomon.profile: A lion-headed warrior of noble heart. He draws the Lion Sword from across his back to cut and thrust, and once his fighting spirit is full he looses the Beast King Fist, a lion's head of aura from his right fist.
digimon.digicube.shellmon.profile: A soft-bodied hermit of the shallows who carries a huge spined shell. It shoots water at high pressure from the top of its head.
